answer: Because selection is random and the saffron seed is unrevealed until close, anyone cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a dune gamble with a negative expected value. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check costs the original grader 19% of its standing plus a seat ban. The ocean log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
